g.text: The data model — 28 tables today, and the ones the next milestones add
Prisma owns the schema; twelve migrations have been applied. The dashed cluster is not written yet: it is what M3 to M8 will add.
7 tables · Better Auth owns the first four
3 tables · all erased or tombstoned on deletion
5 tables · roles, levels and stacks are content
13 tables · one version-history table serves every editable entity
A question’s vector lives in a pgvector column with a hand-written HNSW index. Prisma cannot see it, so it has proposed dropping it in four separate migrations — each one deleted by hand.

Rows that must be kept after an account is erased — payments, subscriptions, webhook events, audit logs, AI call logs — reference the user by a plain uuid with no foreign key, replaced by a tombstone id.
Question.planned_follow_ups and ideal_points are answer key: they exist in the database and in the CMS, and no candidate-facing response has a field they could occupy.
